map.本工具用于检测（浓度/PH/细菌）服务的合法性校验，依据对应数据格式与语法规范实: This tool validates the (concentration / pH / bacteria) testing service against the corresponding data format and syntax rules in real time, locating errors; it runs entirely in the browser and uploads no data.
map.📚 深度解析：消毒液三项检测判定（浓度/PH/细菌）: 📚 Deep Dive: Three-Item Test for Disinfectant (Concentration / pH / Bacteria)
map.消毒产品进场自检：按浓度、PH、细菌总数三项判定: Disinfectant incoming self-check: judge by three items — concentration, pH, total bacteria
map.卫生安全：细菌总数是微生物限量核心: Hygiene safety: total bacteria is the core microbiological limit
map.报告可用性：三项全合格方可用于卫生验收: Report usability: all three must pass before hygiene acceptance
map.逐项判定：浓度 2~5%、PH 7~9、细菌总数≤100CFU/mL；三项均满足: Item-by-item: concentration 2~5%, pH 7~9, total bacteria ≤ 100 CFU/mL; all three satisfied = pass. Too-low concentration is ineffective, too-high irritates; pH and bacteria relate to safety and preservation.
map.浓度 3%（区间✓）、PH 8（区间✓）、细菌 50CFU/mL（≤100 ✓）: Concentration 3% (range ✓), pH 8 (range ✓), bacteria 50 CFU/mL (≤100 ✓): all three pass → qualified. If bacteria rises to 150 CFU/mL it fails, microbiological excess.
map.浓度为何要区间而非越高越好？: Why is concentration a range rather than the higher the better?
map.浓度过低杀菌不足、过高腐蚀刺激与残留大；2~5% 为常用有效且较安全区间，须按消: Too-low concentration gives insufficient disinfection; too-high corrodes, irritates, and leaves large residues. 2~5% is a common effective and safer range, subject to disinfectant type.
map.对消毒产品属较严微生物限量，防止二次污染；具体限值随产品类别（如手消、物表）与标: For disinfectants it is a fairly strict microbiological limit to prevent secondary contamination; the specific limit varies by product category (e.g., hand vs. surface) and standard.
map.细菌检测需无菌取样，培养后计数: Bacteria testing requires aseptic sampling and culture-based counting
map.消毒液浓度过低无法有效杀菌: Too-low disinfectant concentration cannot disinfect effectively
map.关于「检测（浓度/PH/细菌）服务」: About the Concentration / pH / Bacteria Testing Service
map.消毒液浓度、PH值、细菌总数三项检测工具，依据GB/T 5750、GB/T 97: A three-item testing tool for disinfectant concentration, pH, and total bacteria, judging pass/fail per standards such as GB/T 5750 and GB/T 9724. Suitable for quality testing and hygiene assessment of disinfectants, hand soaps, and medical liquids.
